package.name: PostgreSQL
package.summary: Relational database server; review data directories, service initialization, ports and credentials.

notes: PostgreSQL 17 Windows installer; review selected components, database service, data directory and port.
Credentials belong in native installer prompts and must be excluded from Dev Setup logs and persistence.
PostgreSQL 17 formula; native post-install behavior can initialize a default database cluster. Review the Homebrew data directory before approval.
Review service startup and PATH guidance separately; the psql client alone does not verify server configuration.
Ubuntu 24.04 release-default PostgreSQL server, normally major version 16; this is not a request for PostgreSQL 17.
Native installation can create a database cluster and start a local service. Review data directories, credentials, authentication, ports and backups before approval.
External network exposure requires separate review and consent.

environment_guidance: Server verification must inspect the selected native package and service rather than relying on the psql client version.
Database initialization, deletion, data upgrades and network exposure need separate review and explicit consent.
